actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No one contributed >30 in the last round, wallet is above the free‑rider threshold, so I contribute the minimal 1 unit and broadcast a warning against big contributions.

message.reasoning: We are Resident4, round 0 no history. No one contributed >30 (no contributions). So rule: if any other resident contributed more than 30 units in most recent round -> none. Otherwise, if wallet > free_rider_threshold (100 >10), contribute minimum amount that still counts as contribution (1 unit) to stay below threshold and keep pool small. So contribute 1. Also broadcast discouraging large contributions. So two actions: contribute 1, broadcast message.
